name: fig28_page_curve_ensembles
caption: Ensemble of Haar-random pure states of N qubits; S(R_k) is the entropy of the first k qubits. Dark band: +/- 2 standard errors of the mean (this is the Monte Carlo error); light band: +/- 1 sample standard deviation (the genuine state-to-state fluctuation, which shrinks as N grows). The Monte Carlo mean agrees with the exact average within the statistical error. Results are reproducible for the seeds recorded in the figure sidecar.
